description: Source code for SysLogOutput class implementing IBrowserMetricsLogger, handling browser performance metrics logging, including memory, CPU, and URL load metrics, with telemetry and JSON reporting.

classes.name: SysLogOuput
classes.description: Implements IBrowserMetricsLogger to log browser performance metrics, including URL load, memory, CPU, and telemetry reporting.

classes.name: URLLoadedMetrics
classes.description: Stores metrics related to URL loading, including memory, CPU load, uptime, and load times.

classes.name: MetricsAsJson
classes.description: JSON container for reporting metrics data.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Initializes telemetry, references shell, and queries memory info.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Releases references to shell and memory interfaces.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Logs deactivation reason and sends telemetry.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of URL load, logs metrics.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Records metrics on URL change, including memory, CPU, and load times.

methods.name: OutputLoadFinishedMetrics
methods.description: Prepares and sends JSON metrics report via telemetry.

methods.name: GetProcessStatmLine
methods.description: Reads /proc/[pid]/statm to get process memory info.
